title: 第一卷 第47章 秦家未亡人第一卷 第46章 赵清梦
lines: “好，大嫂！”秦绝抬起头来，郑重道。
“嗯，这就对了。”一声大嫂，唤得赵清梦再次笑着落泪。
赵清梦对他大哥的情谊深至如斯，秦绝还能再说什么？
当然，倘若有一天，赵清梦改了心意，秦绝也会尊重。
因为赵清梦本就不欠秦家的，反而是秦家该记着赵清梦这份大恩。
二人在山间，给每一个坟头都除了草，焚了香。
下山的时候，秦绝扭头朝着山腰方向看了一眼，冷沉道：“以后这座月牙山，就归我秦家所有！谁若敢来扰我家人清静，便是死！”
赵清梦点头道：“以你现在的威望，买下这座山，城主府应该会同意的。”
秦绝冷然道：“他们不同意也得同意！身为凤州城城主，凌天啸有太多不作为了！他想安逸的混日子可以，但前提是别惹怒了我。”
赵清梦道：“小绝，我知道你现在的实力很强，但城主府毕竟是武朝的官方势力，能不得罪，还是尽量别得罪。”
秦绝没有应话，只道：“大嫂，我们先回城吧。”
赵清梦见状，也不再多言，点了点头，和秦绝一道朝着凤州城返回。
秦府外，一个妇人带着一个身穿青色襦裙的少女，以及两名丫鬟在等候着。
小青也站在门口，朝着远处观望着。
蓦然，小青眼神一喜，出声道：“李夫人，我家少爷和赵姑娘回来了。”
妇人和襦裙少女一喜，连忙朝着小青所指的方向看去。
果然，秦绝和赵清梦二人，一人骑着黑虎，一人骑着黑豹，正朝着秦府而来。
白狼要留下镇宅，所以秦绝骑着冷风华的那头异兽坐骑黑虎。
“清梦！”
妇人声音一哽，远远的，便是急着呼喊道。
听到这熟悉的声音，赵清梦也是眼神一颤，连忙催使黑豹，疾奔了过去。
“母亲！”
赵清梦叫唤了一声，跳下黑豹，和妇人紧紧相拥在一起。
“姐姐，你终于回来了，婉儿想死你了！”襦裙少女也是眼眶一红，跑过去和赵清梦、李芝拥成一团。
这少女，是赵清梦的妹妹赵清婉，年纪比秦绝还要小上三岁。
“母亲，是女儿不孝。婉儿，你都和姐姐一般高了，时间过得真快。”赵清梦抱着二人，眼中泪光浮动。
“没事，你回来了就好！回来了就好。”李芝激动之下，已是泣不成声。
离家的这四年，赵清梦一次都没有和赵家联系过。
因为她不想听到任何她不想听到的话。
秦毅不在了，她担心赵家会让她与他人另立婚约！
这种事，她相信她的那个爷爷干得出来！
哪怕她可以拒绝，但也不想为这事而糟心，索性就不联系。
而且，为了能够拥有为秦家报仇的实力，这四年来，赵清梦基本都在闭关苦修。
这次也是因为云山秘境开启将近，这才出关的。
秦绝从后方骑虎过来，他这才知道，原来大嫂回城后，连赵家都没回，就直奔秦府来了。
content_en:
"Okay, sister-in-law!" Qin Jue raised his head and said solemnly.
"Well, that's right." The voice of "Sister-in-law" made Zhao Qingmeng laugh and cry again.
Zhao Qingmeng's friendship for his eldest brother is so deep, what else can Qin Jue say?
Of course, if one day, Zhao Qingmeng changes his mind, Qin Jue will respect it.
Because Zhao Qingmeng does not owe the Qin family anything, but the Qin family should remember Zhao Qingmeng's great kindness.
The two of them removed grass and burned incense on every grave in the mountains.
When going down the mountain, Qin Jue turned his head and glanced towards the mountainside, and said coldly: "From now on, this Crescent Mountain will belong to my Qin family! Anyone who dares to disturb the peace of my family will die!"
Zhao Qingmeng nodded and said: "With your current prestige, if you buy this mountain, the city lord's palace should agree."
Qin Jue said coldly: "They have to agree even if they don't agree! As the lord of Fengzhou City, Ling Tianxiao has done too much! He can live a leisurely life if he wants, but only if he doesn't anger me."
Zhao Qingmeng said: "Xiao Jue, I know you are very powerful now, but the City Lord's Mansion is the official force of the Wu Dynasty after all. If you can't offend, you should try not to offend."
Qin Jue did not respond, only said: "Sister-in-law, let's go back to the city first."
Seeing this, Zhao Qingmeng said no more, nodded, and returned to Fengzhou City with Qin Jue.
Outside the Qin Mansion, a woman was waiting with a girl wearing a green skirt and two maids.
Xiao Qing also stood at the door, looking into the distance.
Suddenly, Xiaoqing's eyes lit up with joy and she said, "Mrs. Li, my young master and Miss Zhao are back."
The woman and the girl in the undershirt were overjoyed and quickly looked in the direction Xiao Qing pointed.
Sure enough, Qin Jue and Zhao Qingmeng, one riding a black tiger and the other riding a black panther, were heading towards the Qin Mansion.
Bai Lang wanted to stay in the town house, so Qin Jue rode Leng Fenghua's exotic beast mount, the black tiger.
"Qingmeng!"
The woman's voice was choked, and she shouted anxiously from a distance.
Hearing this familiar voice, Zhao Qingmeng's eyes trembled, and he quickly urged the black panther to rush over.
"Mother!"
Zhao Qingmeng called out, jumped off the panther, and hugged the woman tightly.
"Sister, you are finally back. Wan'er misses you so much!" The girl in the undershirt also had red eyes and ran over to hug Zhao Qingmeng and Li Zhi.
This girl is Zhao Qingmeng's younger sister Zhao Qingwan, who is three years younger than Qin Jue.
"Mother, your daughter is unfilial. Wan'er, you are as tall as your sister. Time flies so fast." Zhao Qingmeng hugged the two of them with tears in her eyes.
"It's okay, it'll be good if you're back! It'll be good if you're back." Li Zhi was so excited that she burst into tears.
In the four years since leaving home, Zhao Qingmeng has not contacted the Zhao family once.
Because she doesn't want to hear anything she doesn't want to hear.
Qin Yi is gone, and she is worried that the Zhao family will let her enter into another marriage contract with someone else!
She believed that her grandfather could do such a thing!
Even though she could refuse, she didn't want to be upset about it, so she simply stopped contacting him.
Moreover, in order to have the strength to avenge the Qin family, Zhao Qingmeng has been practicing hard in seclusion for the past four years.
This time it was also because the Yunshan Secret Realm was about to open, so I came out of it.
Qin Jue came riding a tiger from behind. Only then did he know that after his sister-in-law returned to the city, she didn't even return to the Zhao family and went straight to the Qin mansion.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 47 The Widow of the Qin Family Volume 1 Chapter 46 Zhao Qingmeng
